records.question: Show me the top 5 event categories by total revenue.
records.sql:
SELECT e.category, ROUND(SUM(t.price), 2) AS revenue
FROM tickets t
JOIN events e ON e.event_id = t.event_id
WHERE t.status = 'sold'
  AND e.event_date < '2026-09-12'
GROUP BY e.category
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 5

records.question: How many tickets were sold for Brooklyn Nets home games last month?
records.sql:
SELECT e.name, e.event_date, COUNT(*) AS tickets_sold
FROM tickets t
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = t.order_id
JOIN events e ON e.event_id = t.event_id
JOIN teams h ON h.team_id = e.home_team_id
WHERE t.status = 'sold'
  AND h.name = 'Brooklyn Nets'
  AND o.ordered_at >= date('2026-09-12', 'start of month', '-1 month')
  AND o.ordered_at < date('2026-09-12', 'start of month')
GROUP BY e.event_id
ORDER BY tickets_sold DESC
LIMIT 501

records.question: Which events at Barclays Center had the highest average ticket price in 2024?
records.sql:
SELECT e.name, e.event_date, ROUND(AVG(t.price), 2) AS average_price
FROM tickets t
JOIN events e ON e.event_id = t.event_id
JOIN venues v ON v.venue_id = e.venue_id
WHERE t.status = 'sold'
  AND v.name = 'Barclays Center'
  AND e.event_date >= '2024-01-01' AND e.event_date < '2025-01-01'
GROUP BY e.event_id
ORDER BY average_price DESC
LIMIT 10

records.question: How much revenue did we lose to refunds last season?
records.sql:
WITH last_season AS (
  SELECT s.home_team_id, MAX(s.season) AS season
  FROM events s
  JOIN teams c ON c.team_id = s.home_team_id
  WHERE c.is_home_club = 1
    AND s.season NOT IN (
      SELECT x.season FROM events x
      WHERE x.home_team_id = c.team_id AND x.event_date >= '2026-09-12'
    )
  GROUP BY s.home_team_id
)
SELECT h.name AS club, e.season, ROUND(SUM(t.price), 2) AS revenue_lost_to_refunds
FROM tickets t
JOIN events e ON e.event_id = t.event_id
JOIN last_season ls ON ls.home_team_id = e.home_team_id AND ls.season = e.season
JOIN teams h ON h.team_id = e.home_team_id
WHERE t.status = 'refunded'
GROUP BY h.team_id, e.season
ORDER BY h.name
LIMIT 501

records.question: How many tickets did the Liberty sell last season?
records.sql:
WITH last_season AS (
  SELECT MAX(s.season) AS season
  FROM events s
  JOIN teams c ON c.team_id = s.home_team_id
  WHERE c.name = 'New York Liberty'
    AND s.season NOT IN (
      SELECT x.season FROM events x
      WHERE x.home_team_id = c.team_id AND x.event_date >= '2026-09-12'
    )
)
SELECT e.season, COUNT(*) AS tickets_sold
FROM tickets t
JOIN events e ON e.event_id = t.event_id
JOIN teams h ON h.team_id = e.home_team_id
WHERE t.status = 'sold'
  AND h.name = 'New York Liberty'
  AND e.season = (SELECT season FROM last_season)
GROUP BY e.season
LIMIT 501

records.question: Which Liberty home games sold the most tickets this season?
records.sql:
WITH this_season AS (
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM events e JOIN teams t ON t.team_id = e.home_team_id
      WHERE t.name = 'New York Liberty' AND e.event_date < '2026-09-12'
    ) AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM events e JOIN teams t ON t.team_id = e.home_team_id
      WHERE t.name = 'New York Liberty' AND e.event_date >= '2026-09-12'
    )
    THEN (
      SELECT e.season FROM events e JOIN teams t ON t.team_id = e.home_team_id
      WHERE t.name = 'New York Liberty' AND e.event_date < '2026-09-12'
      ORDER BY e.event_date DESC LIMIT 1
    )
    ELSE (
      SELECT e.season FROM events e JOIN teams t ON t.team_id = e.home_team_id
      WHERE t.name = 'New York Liberty' AND e.event_date >= '2026-09-12'
      ORDER BY e.event_date ASC LIMIT 1
    )
  END AS season
)
SELECT e.name, e.event_date, COUNT(*) AS tickets_sold
FROM tickets t
JOIN events e ON e.event_id = t.event_id
JOIN teams h ON h.team_id = e.home_team_id
WHERE t.status = 'sold'
  AND h.name = 'New York Liberty'
  AND e.season = (SELECT season FROM this_season)
GROUP BY e.event_id
ORDER BY tickets_sold DESC
LIMIT 10

records.question: How many orders used a promo code this year?
records.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders_with_promo
FROM orders
WHERE promo_code IS NOT NULL
  AND strftime('%Y', ordered_at) = strftime('%Y', '2026-09-12')
LIMIT 501

records.question: How many tickets were refunded for concerts held in 2025?
records.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS refunded_tickets
FROM tickets t
JOIN events e ON e.event_id = t.event_id
WHERE t.status = 'refunded'
  AND e.category = 'Concert'
  AND e.event_date >= '2025-01-01' AND e.event_date < '2026-01-01'
LIMIT 501

records.question: How many tickets did we sell in the first quarter of 2026?
records.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS tickets_sold
FROM tickets t
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = t.order_id
WHERE t.status = 'sold'
  AND o.ordered_at >= '2026-01-01' AND o.ordered_at < '2026-04-01'
LIMIT 501

records.question: Which opponent sold the most tickets at Brooklyn Nets home games in the 2025-26 season?
records.sql:
SELECT a.name AS opponent, COUNT(*) AS tickets_sold
FROM tickets t
JOIN events e ON e.event_id = t.event_id
JOIN teams h ON h.team_id = e.home_team_id
JOIN teams a ON a.team_id = e.away_team_id
WHERE t.status = 'sold'
  AND h.name = 'Brooklyn Nets'
  AND e.season = '2025-26'
GROUP BY a.team_id
ORDER BY tickets_sold DESC
LIMIT 1
